item.title: San Diego man invents the BurriTote, a bag to keep your burrito warm
item.description: A San Diego native and entrepreneur recounts how a friendly debate led to the invention of the BurriTote, a bag designed just to transport and keep your burrito warm.

item.title: Don Hansen, founder of Hansen Surfboards, dies at 89
item.description: The surf icon created some of his most iconic models of boards in this period, including the 50-50, Competitor, Classic, and Superlight — which are still in production today.

item.title: I-805 fatal crash snarls traffic at Murray Ridge Road
item.description: Several lanes are closed on the northbound Interstate 805 due to a fatal crash on Thursday morning. The crash was reported at around 5:30 a.m. at Murray Ridge Road and closed all lanes, but by 6 a.m., two lanes reopened while three lanes remained closed, according to Caltrans. By 8 a.m., all lanes had reopened to traffic. Update: NB I-805…

item.description: Douglas Guyton, 61, was charged with two counts of second degree murder and two charges of gross vehicular manslaughter while intoxicated, according to court documents.

item.title: Tenant of San Marcos fire victims appears in court
item.description: Luis Alvarado, 33, who is accused in the slayings of 73-year-old Michael Austin and Kathryn Austin, 72, was due to be arraigned Thursday but his attorney declared a doubt regarding his competency to stand trial.
